20. Assertion: On freely suspending a current – carrying solenoid, it comes to rest in 1

items.stem: Which of the following materials are attracted by a magnet?
If a bar magnet is broken into two pieces, what happens to its poles?
What is the name of the end of a magnet that points towards the North?
A student observed that a bar magnet attracts iron filings more strongly at its ends. What can be concluded from this?
Which of the following best describes the function of the transparent cover in a magnetic compass?
A student suspends a bar magnet and finds that it always points in the north-south direction. What does this show?
If a steel bar is placed between a magnet and a compass needle, what effect does it have on the compass needle?
What happens when a bar magnet is brought close to a compass needle with its North pole facing the compass's North pole?
Which of the following is the best way to determine if a steel piece is magnetized?
A magnet has two poles. What is the correct statement about the poles of a magnet?
If a freely suspended magnet rests along the north-south direction, what does this indicate?
In a diagram showing three bar magnets, how can you determine the polarity at the ends of the magnets?
If two ring magnets are placed on a scale with their poles in alternate North-South fashion, what will happen if the magnets are allowed to move freely?
If a magnet does not have its poles marked, how can you determine which end is the North pole?
If a magnet is broken into pieces, what will happen to its poles?
Based on the information in the passage, what is the correct interaction when two bar magnets are placed with their North poles facing each other?
Reshma bought three identical metal bars from the market. Out of these bars, two were magnets and one was just a piece of iron. How will she identify which two amongst the three could be magnets?
Which of the following statements is true about magnets?
If the Earth is itself a magnet, can you guess the poles of Earth’s magnet by looking at the direction of the magnetic compass?
What is the correct way to store a magnet according to the passage?
Two ring magnets X and Y are arranged as shown in Fig. 4.16. It is observed that the magnet X does not move down further. What could be the possible reason?
What is the purpose of the dial marked with directions in a magnetic compass?
Based on the interaction between two bar magnets, which property of magnets can be identified?
Reshma places a bar magnet near a compass needle. She then places a piece of cardboard between them. What will happen to the compass needle's deflection?
Two identical steel pieces are placed near each other, and there is attraction between them. Which of the following arrangements would help determine which piece is magnetized?
What is the primary purpose of a magnetic compass?
What happens when the North pole of a bar magnet is brought close to the North pole of a compass needle?
Which of the following is a magnetic material?
If a magnet is broken into smaller pieces, what happens?
What is the function of the iron needle in a magnetic compass?
What happens to iron filings when placed near a bar magnet?
What does a freely suspended bar magnet indicate about the Earth?
